Original_Header: The PHMSA Pipeline Safety Flagged Incidents files include data from four different pipeline system types (Hazardous Liquid, Gas Transmission/Gathering, Gas Distribution, and LNG) and two different time periods over which data was collected from operators using different reporting forms. As such, some reported data, such as the apparent incident cause, do not have equivalence over historical data sets. In order to group incidents over all periods by cause in a consistent way it was necessary for PHMSA to develop a mapping system whereby the apparent cause data reported by operators over all time periods and system types could be standardized to the extent possible.
